updates.sentence: Juvenile detention reported; no verified fixed sentence or release date. The Black Panther of December 20, 1969 reports that Wilson, age 16, had already been jailed following separate juvenile proceedings when she was called to testify at the New Haven bail hearing ending December 5. The article describes indefinite juvenile detention, not a fixed criminal sentence or a verified term actually served until age 21. Individual admission and discharge dates remain unverified. Source: https://washingtonareaspark.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/1969-12-20-black-panther-vol-4-no-3.pdf#page=3
